name: reliefchain
description: AI-powered disaster micro-relief for Kampala, Uganda — AI triage + PayPal Payouts

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build
